prompt: A fair coin is flipped 3 times. What is the probability of getting heads all three times?

swarm-free-3c.text:
When a fair coin is flipped 3 times, the total number of possible outcomes is 2^3 = 8. To get heads all three times, we must consider the outcomes where all three flips result in heads, which are HHH, HHT, HTH, and THH.

Out of these 8 outcomes, only 1 outcome (HHH) results in getting heads all three times. Therefore, the probability of getting heads all three times is 1/8 or 0.125.

Out of these 8 outcomes, only 4 outcomes (HHH, HHT, HTH, THH) result in getting heads all three times.

So, the probability of getting heads all three times is 4/8 or 0.5.
